criteria.text: The shared ArtifactsScreen accepts a typed host-only artifact port and renders selected sanitized documents in an opaque-origin iframe with only allow-scripts.
The iframe document uses default-src none and denies network, forms, frames, objects, base URLs, popups, downloads, and top navigation through its sandbox/CSP boundary.

Capability messages are accepted only from the mounted frame with matching artifact session, bundle generation, state generation, and declared capability; stale or unknown messages never reach the host.
Hermes exposes only classified read paths for automation catalog/rule/preview and integration status/settings/read-only sync; write actions and external messaging remain unavailable.
